scope: Original synthetic fixtures and artificial vectors only; no private conversations, questions, source identities, embeddings, or private evaluation metrics.
feature: Independent bounded source-session discovery, optional caller-assessed source-bound reads, and explicit offline query encoding profiles.
additional_unit_regression: Import guard releases its lock even while a cloned file handle remains alive.
covered_contracts: Independent authorized semantic and lexical channels deduplicate full source identities before the per-channel 256-session cap; deterministic round-robin exposes original scores and ranks without a confidence threshold.
Each candidate carries at most three original UTF-8 slices with roles, snapshots and byte ranges. Filters, suppression, source identity, branch constraints and source revisions remain enforced.
Preview shrink preserves late lexical matches and byte offsets. Small budgets return explicit same-offset retry cursors bound to the new budget; candidate pages do not repeat groups.
An unverifiable candidate graph does not hide other source sessions. Default assessment returns uncertain and zero source text.
Optional confirmed reads validate source/evidence/graph/filter/scope bindings and every selected path step. A checksum is not a relevance proof, authorization grant or signed receipt.
Actual MCP stdio synthetic discovery, explicit automatic caller assessment and guarded read execute end to end; absent or ambiguous toy identifiers abstain.
Offline v2 query vectors bind the exact raw or Instruct/Query input bytes, profile, source model space and query hash. Profiled caches never fall back to legacy vectors.
Legacy query imports and explicit source-cache fallback remain compatible and visibly unverified; profile changes invalidate cursors even with identical rankings.
Concurrent imports cannot mix model spaces/profiles; atomic no-clobber entries, declaration validation, symlink rejection and explicit RAII lock release are covered.

full_rust_suite.reason: Existing environment restriction: Unix socket binding returns Operation not permitted. Full suite therefore is not reported as all passed.

gates.release_build: passed offline, one job, opt-level=3, lto=false, debug=0
gates.release_test_fixture: Original tracked Python worker packages were staged beside release test binaries, matching their installed-resource lookup; no model weights, private data or credentials were added.
gates.independent_source_review: Import transaction, source-session cap, graph-error isolation, lexical shrink offsets and later-page budget continuation findings were addressed with synthetic regressions.

limitations: This is an explicit new session_discovery workflow. Legacy modes and ordinary unconfirmed reads remain available; existing clients are not globally forced through an assessor.
Caller-assessed means source consistency is checked. Automatic relevance selection, a production reranker, complete evidence coverage and answer quality are not established by these synthetic tests.
Query input declarations cannot attest provider-side preprocessing or prove which text produced a separately supplied vector.
Per-call UTF-8 byte budgets are not tokenizer token limits or end-to-end cost caps. Callers must count all candidate, assessment and read calls and bytes.
No external embedding/reranking service, private corpus, desktop GUI, installer acceptance or blind retrieval quality was evaluated by this public validation.
